title: poa arctica subsp. aperta
intro: Poa arctica subsp. aperta, commonly known as Arctic Bluegrass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to the Arctic regions and has been used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Poa arctica subsp. aperta include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and may be used to treat conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases.
